statement:
∀ (f' g g' F : ℝ → ℝ),
  (∀ (x : ℝ), HasDerivAt g (g' x) x) →
    (∀ (x : ℝ), HasDerivAt (fun t => sin t * f' t) (F x) x) →
      Continuous g' →
        Continuous F → Continuous f' → ∫ (θ : ℝ) in 0..π, g θ * F θ = -∫ (θ : ℝ) in 0..π, g' θ * (sin θ * f' θ)

universal.type: ∀ (x : ℝ), HasDerivAt (fun t => sin t * f' t) (F x) x
universal.name: hF

fun θ => g' θ * (sin θ * f' θ)

goal.rhs: -∫ (θ : ℝ) in 0..π, g' θ * (sin θ * f' θ)
goal.lhs: ∫ (θ : ℝ) in 0..π, g θ * F θ
